guitar.notes: Steve Miller is well known for playing custom Fender Stratocasters extensively throughout his career.

tone.target: clean, spacey 70s space-rock guitar with chorus and delay

tone.summary: A classic 70s space-rock sound achieved using a Fender-style clean amp (US Deluxe), enhanced by Chorus for width, Digital Delay for signature repeats, and Spring Reverb for vintage ambience.
